label: Source support for 8554d4f7 from I q.80 a.1–2
note: The account supplies appetite toward an object as intellectually apprehended, against restricting all appetite to sense or natural inclination alone. The route must show that every InclinedTo tied to an Intelligible form is such a response rather than a natural inclination belonging to an intellectual nature, and that its response warrants a principle bearing both AppetitivePowerOf and FollowsIntellect over the selected domain.
